description_en: Organization ID for Workload Identity Federation. Set it together with ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID. See authentication precedence
description_ja: Workload Identity Federation用の組織IDであり、ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_IDと組み合わせて設定します。
use_case_ja:
- Workload Identity Federationを利用する際に、ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_IDとともに設定して認証プロセスを確立するために使用します。
- 本環境変数はClaude Code起動時にのみ読み込まれ、/loginによる通常のユーザー認証より優先される認証ソースとして機能します。
doc_snippets: Source Set by Rank against /login Named profile ANTHROPIC_PROFILE Above, whichever auth mode the profile has Federation variables ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID and ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID , both set Above Active profile The active_config file in your configuration directory, or a profile named default Above when its auth mode is oidc_federation ; below a working /login credential when its auth mode is user_oauth The user_oauth rule keeps a leftover ant auth login profile from moving your requests off the account you signed in to with /login . For the federation variables, Claude Code also reads the other variables in the WIF reference , such as ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE , when it exchanges your identity token. For the profile file format, see the WIF reference .
